annotations.title: Company identity lookup (SEC EDGAR + GLEIF LEI merge)

description: [PAID — 0.01 USDC on Base via x402] Normalized company-identity record from a name, ticker, LEI, or CIK: legal name, LEI, CIK (if SEC-registered), tickers/exchanges, jurisdiction, legal address, entity/registration status, and direct/ultimate parent. Merges SEC EDGAR (www.sec.gov, public domain) with GLEIF's LEI reference API (api.gleif.org, CC0 open data) — a global scope broader than the category leader's French-registry-only data. Exactly one of name(/q alias)/ticker/lei/cik required; ambiguous name queries return top_matches instead of guessing. $0.01 USDC on Base, paid via x402 by the calling agent's own wallet. Call with no payment_header first to receive the payment requirements; your own wallet pays, never this server's.

cik.description: SEC Central Index Key. Mutually exclusive with name/ticker/lei.

lei.description: 20-character ISO 17442 Legal Entity Identifier. Mutually exclusive with name/ticker/cik.

name.description: Company name for fuzzy search across SEC + GLEIF. Mutually exclusive with ticker/lei/cik.

payment_header.description: Optional. Omit on your first call to receive the x402 payment challenge for free. After your own wallet/x402 client signs against that challenge, call this same tool again with the SAME business arguments plus this field set to the header your x402 client produced (typically { name: "PAYMENT-SIGNATURE", value: "<base64 payload>" }). This server never holds a wallet and never pays on your behalf.

name.description: HTTP header name to attach, e.g. PAYMENT-SIGNATURE.

value.description: HTTP header value (the signed payment payload).

q.description: Alias for name (compatibility with the leading company-lookup comparable's param name).

ticker.description: SEC-registered stock ticker, e.g. 'AAPL'. Mutually exclusive with name/lei/cik.

name: company_lookup
